__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus datasource scraping the Spring Boot Actuator /actuator/prometheus endpoint

description: AWS CardDemo (COBOL->Java/Spring Boot migration) operational dashboard. Visualizes JVM/health, HTTP controller routes, Spring Batch jobs/steps, and HikariCP datasource metrics from Micrometer via the Prometheus registry (/actuator/prometheus).

panels.title: Availability
panels.description: Prometheus target health (`up`): 1=UP, 0=DOWN.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: JVM process uptime.

panels.title: Process CPU
panels.description: Recent CPU usage of the JVM process.

panels.title: System CPU
panels.description: Recent CPU usage of the whole system.

panels.title: Heap Used %
panels.description: Heap used / heap max.

targets.expr: sum(jvm_memory_used_bytes{area="heap", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) / sum(jvm_memory_max_bytes{area="heap", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Live Threads
panels.description: Current live (daemon + non-daemon) threads.

panels.title: Classes Loaded
panels.description: Loaded JVM classes.

panels.title: GC Pause (avg)
panels.description: Average GC pause duration over the rate window.

panels.title: Heap Memory
panels.description: Heap memory used/committed/max.

panels.title: Non-Heap Memory
panels.description: Non-heap (metaspace, code cache, etc.) memory.

panels.title: Memory Pools (used)
panels.description: Used memory broken down by JVM memory pool id.

panels.title: GC Pause Time
panels.description: Average GC pause seconds and collection frequency by action/cause.

panels.title: Threads
panels.description: Live / daemon / peak thread counts.

panels.title: Classes Loaded
panels.description: Number of classes currently loaded in the JVM.

panels.title: Request Rate
panels.description: Overall HTTP request rate across all routes.

panels.title: Error % (4xx/5xx)
panels.description: Percentage of requests with a 4xx/5xx outcome.

panels.title: Latency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile latency. Requires percentiles-histogram buckets (see HTTP latency panel description).

panels.title: Latency p99
panels.description: 99th percentile latency. Requires percentiles-histogram buckets.

panels.title: Request Rate by URI
panels.description: Per-route request rate (one series per controller URI template).

panels.title: Request Rate by Method
panels.description: Request rate grouped by HTTP method.

panels.title: Error Rate by Status
panels.description: 4xx/5xx response rate grouped by HTTP status code.

panels.title: Avg Latency by URI
panels.description: Mean request latency per route (sum/count of the Timer).

panels.title: Latency Percentiles (p50/p95/p99)
panels.description: PREREQUISITE: these percentile series read http_server_requests_seconds_bucket, which is only emitted when `management.metrics.distribution.percentiles-histogram.http.server.requests=true` is set in application.yml (owned by the resources agent). If unset, this panel shows NO DATA (not an error) — expected template behavior.

panels.title: Max Latency by URI
panels.description: Max observed latency per route from the Timer _max gauge.

panels.title: Active Jobs
panels.description: Currently executing jobs (spring.batch.job.active LongTaskTimer active count).

panels.title: Job Executions
panels.description: Cumulative completed job executions.

panels.title: Job Failures
panels.description: Completed job executions with status FAILURE.

panels.title: Avg Job Duration
panels.description: Mean job execution duration.

panels.title: Job Execution Rate by Name / Status
panels.description: Job completion rate grouped by job name and SUCCESS/FAILURE status.

panels.title: Avg Job Duration by Name
panels.description: Mean execution duration per job name.

panels.title: Avg Step Duration by Step
panels.description: Mean execution duration per step name.

panels.title: Item Read / Process / Chunk-Write Rate
panels.description: Chunk-oriented step throughput: item read, item process, chunk write rates.

panels.title: Active Connections
panels.description: Connections currently in use.

panels.title: Idle Connections
panels.description: Idle connections available in the pool.

panels.title: Pending Threads
panels.description: Threads awaiting a connection (saturation signal).

panels.title: Connection Timeouts
panels.description: Cumulative connection-acquisition timeouts.

panels.title: Connection Pool State
panels.description: Active/idle/pending against configured min/max pool size.

panels.title: Connection Acquire Time (avg)
panels.description: Mean time to acquire a connection from the pool.

panels.title: Connection Usage Time (avg)
panels.description: Mean time a connection is held before being returned.

panels.title: Connection Creation Time (avg)
panels.description: Mean time to physically establish a new connection.

title: AWS CardDemo — Spring Boot Observability
